calibration._comment: background_frames: number of frames to capture for background model
calibration._comment2: corner_inset: fraction Godot insets calibration markers from the screen edge (0.05 = 5%)

detection._comment: touch_threshold_mm: how much closer than background a pixel must be to count as a touch

tracker._comment: confirm_frames: consecutive frames before a cell fires DOWN
tracker._comment2: release_frames: consecutive absent frames before a cell fires UP

grid._comment: Default grid size — Godot can override at runtime via /captcha/grid_size
